threadC_verdict: WEAKENED — the coda-sonority concretization (the natural 3-column form): formal pre-reg bar gave INCONCLUSIVE (lag-3 z=+11.9 hit, momentum missed), but follow-up shows the lag-3 hit is a DIFFERENT phenomenon (flat bursty profile, no spike vs the cipher sharp spike) and the momentum sign is robustly OPPOSITE (anti-momentum z=-65, stable under 50%-purity noise: attenuated to z~-12, never flipped). Onset-sonority variant dead outright (lag-3 z=-5.85). Anchor probe inconclusive (p=0.12, n=16). The general refuge ("some other untested linguistic class") remains logically open but has NO concretization with positive evidence. Full KILL of the refuge needs key recovery (phase-perp-class at n>>), per pre-reg.

C1_exploratory_shape.note: NOT pre-registered; follow-up to interpret the lag-3 z=+11.9 hit.
C1_exploratory_shape.finding: plaintext coda-class lag profile is FLAT (0.41-0.44, no spike); the cipher labeled stream has a SHARP lag-3 spike (0.36 vs 0.24-0.30). The z=+11.9 is elevation over Markov expectation in a flat profile (burstiness), NOT the cipher periodicity phenomenon.

C1_noise_stability.note: NOT pre-registered; tests whether N43(c) 50%-purity noise can flip momentum sign.
C1_noise_stability.method: Tocqueville-T1 coda stream; 3 trials of random relabeling (keep w.p. 0.5 else random class); P2a recomputed.
C1_noise_stability.finding: 50%-purity noise ATTENUATES anti-momentum (z -43.5 -> ~-12) but does NOT flip its sign. The cipher positive momentum (z=+4.77) cannot arise from a coda-class anti-momentum process seen through random 50%-purity labeling. Sign flip would need a specific systematic-mislabeling story (none proposed).

C1_onset_variant_exploratory.note: NOT pre-registered; second natural 3-class concretization (onset sonority: VOW/SON/OBS).
C1_onset_variant_exploratory.finding: Onset-sonority columns DEAD: lag-3 BELOW Markov expectation (z=-5.85), flat profile, anti-momentum.
